title: Armies in the Wilderness
summary: The Lamanite armies followed their brethren into the wilderness as Nephite armies were positioned around Jershon and the borders of Zarahemla.
locations: borders of the land of Zarahemla

explicit_facts.text: The people of Ammon and a church were established in Jershon, and Nephite armies were set around Jershon and the borders of Zarahemla.
The Lamanite armies followed their brethren into the wilderness.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The armies are positioned in the named lands and borders, with the Lamanite army moving into the wilderness.
unspecified_visual_details: The armies' exact size, formations, clothing, weapons, and terrain.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the people of Ammon, church members, or Lamanites' brethren as present; the verse does not place them visibly in this moment.

title: The Great Battle
summary: A tremendous battle took place, and tens of thousands of Lamanites were slain and scattered.

explicit_facts.text: A tremendous battle occurred, unlike any known since Lehi left Jerusalem, and tens of thousands of Lamanites were slain and scattered.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Opposing armies are engaged in battle; non-graphic combat and scattered figures may convey the stated outcome.
unspecified_visual_details: The battle's exact location, tactics, weapons, and the identities of individual fighters.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict gore, wounds, blood, or severed body parts.

title: The Nephites Return
summary: There was a great slaughter among the Nephites; the Lamanites were driven and scattered, and the Nephites returned to their land.

explicit_facts.text: There was a tremendous slaughter among the Nephites; the Lamanites were driven and scattered, and the Nephites returned to their land.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The retreating Lamanites and returning Nephites can be shown as separate movements within this aftermath.
unspecified_visual_details: The route, terrain, and exact place of the battle and return.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show slain individuals or graphic injury.

title: Mourning Across the Land
summary: Mourning was heard throughout the Nephite land as people grieved for slain kindred, including husbands, sons, brothers, and fathers.

explicit_facts.text: Great mourning and lamentation were heard throughout the land among the Nephites.
Widows mourned husbands, fathers mourned sons, daughters mourned brothers, and brothers mourned fathers slain among their kindred.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A group of mourners may be shown expressing grief, without asserting specific individual identities beyond the relationships stated.
unspecified_visual_details: The mourners' appearances, number, gathering places, and whether they mourn together or separately.
prohibited_inventions: Do not portray specific deaths or assign names to mourners or the slain.

title: A Day of Solemnity
summary: The people experienced a sorrowful, solemn day marked by much fasting and prayer.

explicit_facts.text: It was a sorrowful day and a time of solemnity, much fasting, and prayer.

reasonable_visual_inferences: People may be depicted in quiet prayer or fasting, without specifying a ritual or setting.
unspecified_visual_details: Where the people fasted and prayed, and the form of their prayers.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent spoken prayers or a particular worship ceremony.

title: The Fifteenth Year Ends
summary: The fifteenth year of the reign of the judges over the Nephites ended.

explicit_facts.text: The fifteenth year of the reign of the judges over the Nephites ended.

unspecified_visual_details: Any visual marker or object used to signify the passing of the year.

narration.text: And thus endeth the fifteenth year of the reign of the judges over the people of Nephi;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: This is a chronological summary, not a narrated visible event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent a judge, ceremony, or scene of a calendar being marked.

title: Account of Ammon and His Brethren
summary: The account recalls Ammon and his brethren's journeyings, sufferings, sorrows, afflictions, joy, and the reception and safety of the brethren in Jershon; it closes with a blessing.

explicit_facts.text: The account concerns Ammon and his brethren's journeyings in Nephi, their sufferings, sorrows, afflictions, joy, and the brethren's reception and safety in Jershon.
The narrator offers a blessing for their souls from the Lord, the Redeemer of all men.

unspecified_visual_details: Any visual depiction of the summarized journey, the brethren, or the blessing.

narration.text: And now may the Lord, the Redeemer of all men, bless their souls forever.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse summarizes prior events rather than narrating them as a present scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show Ammon or his brethren in a new event or depict the Lord appearing; no appearance is described.

title: Wars and Contentions Recalled
summary: The account concerns wars and contentions among the Nephites and wars between the Nephites and Lamanites; the fifteenth year ended.

explicit_facts.text: The account concerns wars and contentions among the Nephites and wars between the Nephites and Lamanites.
The fifteenth year of the reign of the judges ended.

unspecified_visual_details: Any specific war, battle, person, or place to depict.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: This is a summary, not a newly occurring battle scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not turn the summary into a present-tense battle.

title: Lives Lost Over Fifteen Years
summary: The years from the first through the fifteenth brought many thousands of deaths; many bodies lay in the earth or in heaps, while many mourned their kindred and feared endless woe for them.

explicit_facts.text: The first through fifteenth years brought the destruction of many thousand lives and an awful scene of bloodshed.
Many thousands of bodies were laid in the earth or moldering in heaps, and many mourned their kindred, fearing they were consigned to endless woe according to the Lord's promises.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Mourners may be shown alongside non-graphic signs of death, without identifying a particular battle or time.
unspecified_visual_details: The bodies' identities, specific location, and the circumstances of their deaths.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: These verses summarize losses across a span of years rather than narrating one discrete battle.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict gore, blood, wounds, or severed body parts; do not identify the dead or assign them to a particular battle.

title: Mourning and Hope
summary: Many mourned their kindred yet rejoiced in the hope, and knowledge from the Lord's promises, that they were raised to dwell at God's right hand in never-ending happiness.

explicit_facts.text: Many mourned their kindred but rejoiced and exulted in the hope, and knew according to the Lord's promises that they were raised to dwell at God's right hand in never-ending happiness.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The contrast between grief and hope may be conveyed through mourners' expressions without visualizing heaven or the dead.
unspecified_visual_details: The mourners' identities and any visible depiction of God's right hand or the promised state.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The promise is reported as belief and hope, not as a narrated visible heavenly scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict deceased people in heaven or God appearing.

title: The Inequality of Man
summary: The narrator reflects that sin and transgression, and the devil's power through cunning plans, bring about great inequality among people.

explicit_facts.text: The narrator attributes the great inequality of man to sin and transgression and the devil's power through cunning plans devised to ensnare people's hearts.

unspecified_visual_details: Any visual representation of the devil, sin, or the figure of speech about ensnaring hearts.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The language is a teaching and metaphor, not a narrated supernatural event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the devil or literal snares as visible events.

title: Sorrow and Rejoicing
summary: The narrator calls people to diligence in the Lord's vineyards and reflects on sorrow for death and destruction and joy because of the light of Christ unto life.

explicit_facts.text: The narrator teaches the call to diligence in laboring in the Lord's vineyards and gives sorrow for death and destruction and joy because of the light of Christ unto life as reasons for sorrow and rejoicing.

unspecified_visual_details: Any vineyard, worker, or visible depiction of the light of Christ.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The vineyard and light language is teaching, not a narrated visible scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not create a literal vineyard scene or depict Christ appearing.
